verdict.rationale: A tax agency with electronic filing rails (Webfile, EDI, approved preparer software) could plausibly offer a test environment, so the axis applies. However, no evidence describes any sandbox or test environment. The only keyless machine surface is a read-only open-data Socrata dataset, which is production public data and not an isolated test environment. Webfile sits behind authenticated production eSystems sessions, and probes found no API docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
